governance_ref: cheese_spreads shelf_map.json — brined_cheeses carved out as separate category per line: 'Brined/aged sub-family with a very different sodium architecture — separate stress test.'

shelf_map.mapping_rationale: Shufersal's brined/salty cheese aisle: בולגרית (Bulgarian white cheese, fat tiers 5/16/24%), פטה (cow/goat/sheep milk, fat tiers 5/16/20%), צפתית (Safed-style soft cheese), חלומי (halloumi, grilled/fried cheese), ריקוטה (ricotta, fresh whey cheese), גבינה מלוחה (generic brined cheese), גבינת מריחה בולגרית (Bulgarian spreadable variant). This is a DISTINCT shelf from 'גבינות לבנות וממרחים' (cheese-spreads category) — brined cheeses are characterised by the brining/salting process, higher sodium architecture, and a different consumption role (salad ingredient, table cheese, cooked). The cheese-spreads shelf_map.json explicitly excludes brined cheeses: 'salty brined cheese (בולגרית, פטה, צפתית, פסטרמה) — Brined/aged sub-family with a very different sodium architecture — separate stress test.' Product searches target the Hebrew category terms used on Shufersal: גבינה בולגרית, גבינת פטה, גבינה צפתית, גבינה מלוחה, חלומי, ריקוטה. Category browse uses the A06 dairy aisle (same parent aisle as cheese-spreads) with name-based filtering to isolate brined types.

sub_pools.basis: Classical Israeli brined white cheese; fat tiers 5/16/24% are variants within pool. Most widely consumed brined cheese type in Israel.
Feta-style brined cheese (cow/goat/sheep); origin variants are scoring candidates. Fat tiers 5/16/20% are variants.
Safed-style semi-soft brine cheese; unique Israeli cheese type. Distinct from peta and bulgari by texture and production method.
Grilling/frying cheese; high-melt-point. Distinct purpose (cooked) vs other brined types (raw/salad). Corpus filter will decide whether to include or route to separate page.
Fresh whey cheese; lower salt than bulgari/feta. Corpus filter and Nutrition Agent methodology will decide scope inclusion.
Residual: branded products not cleanly mapping to above pools (e.g. גבינת מריחה בולגרית, mixed blends).
